# tidycrates

tidycrates reads the [Discogs](https://www.discogs.com/) database
through the [Discogs API](https://www.discogs.com/developers) and
returns tidy tibbles. Releases, master releases, artists and labels come
back with one row each, and their tracklists, credits, formats and
identifiers can be unnested into one row per item.

Requests stay within the rate limit of the API, which is 25 requests a
minute without a token and 60 with one. A request that still hits the
limit is retried. Long lists can be fetched in full with `all = TRUE`,
and responses can be cached for the session.

## Installation

tidycrates is not on CRAN yet. Install it from GitHub:

``` r

pak::pak("mcanzi/tidycrates")
```

## Token

The database can be read without a token, but searching it needs one. A
personal access token also raises the limit to 60 requests a minute.
Generate one in the [developer
settings](https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers) of your Discogs
account and add it to `.Renviron`, so it stays out of your scripts:

``` r

usethis::edit_r_environ()
```

    DISCOGS_TOKEN=your-token

After restarting R, tidycrates uses the token for every request.
[`dig_auth()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_auth.md) sets
a different token for the current session.

## Example

The output below comes from made-up data: the band Juniper Static, the
label Fernhollow Records and their releases do not exist. The package
tests use the same data. The real API returns other records for these
IDs.

[`dig_search()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_search.md)
finds the IDs to start from. It searches releases, master releases,
artists and labels by a query, by filters such as artist, label, format
and year, or by both:

``` r

library(tidycrates)

dig_search("Juniper Static") |>
  dplyr::select(id, type, title, year)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>      id type    title                               year
#>   <int> <chr>   <chr>                              <int>
#> 1  1001 release Juniper Static - Lantern Weather    1994
#> 2  2001 master  Juniper Static - Small Hours Atlas  1994
#> 3  3001 artist  Juniper Static                        NA
```

[`dig_release()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_release.md)
reads a release:

``` r

release <- dig_release(1001)
release |> dplyr::select(title, artist, year, country, label, format)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   title           artist          year country label              format
#>   <chr>           <chr>          <int> <chr>   <chr>              <chr>
#> 1 Lantern Weather Juniper Static  1994 UK      Fernhollow Records Vinyl
```

The tracklist, credits, formats and identifiers are list columns.
[`dig_tracklist()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md),
[`dig_credits()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md),
[`dig_formats()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md)
and
[`dig_identifiers()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md)
turn them into one row per item, and `seconds` gives each duration in
seconds:

``` r

dig_tracklist(release)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   release_id position type  title                 artist duration seconds
#>        <int> <chr>    <chr> <chr>                 <chr>  <chr>      <int>
#> 1       1001 A        track Lantern Weather       <NA>   3:32         212
#> 2       1001 B        track Lantern Weather (Dub) <NA>   3:30         210

dig_credits(release) |> dplyr::select(name, credited_as, role)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   name               credited_as role
#>   <chr>              <chr>       <chr>
#> 1 Paperweight Design Paperweight Design
#> 2 Ida Marsh          <NA>        Engineer
#> 3 Tomas Reed         <NA>        Engineer
#> 4 Noor Halden        NH          Lacquer Cut By
#> 5 Felix Arno         Felix A.    Mixed By
#> 6 Malin Ödegaard     M. Ödegaard Producer, Written-By
```

[`dig_artist_releases()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_artist_releases.md)
lists everything an artist appears on, with the number of users who have
each item in their collection or wantlist:

``` r

dig_artist_releases(3001) |>
  dplyr::select(id, type, title, year, have, want)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>      id type    title              year  have  want
#>   <int> <chr>   <chr>             <int> <int> <int>
#> 1  1004 release Moth Radio         1997    43   160
#> 2  2001 master  Small Hours Atlas  1997    70    90
#> 3  2002 master  Paper Moon Signal  1997    25    30
```

[`dig_master_versions()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_master_versions.md)
lists the versions of a master release, which can be filtered by format,
label, year and country:

``` r

dig_master_versions(2001) |>
  dplyr::select(release_id, country, released, major_formats)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   release_id country     released major_formats
#>        <int> <chr>       <chr>    <chr>
#> 1       1001 Bulgaria    1997     Cassette
#> 2       1005 UK & France 1997     CD
#> 3       1006 Poland      1997     Cassette
```

[`dig_collection()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_collection.md)
and
[`dig_wantlist()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_wantlist.md)
list the releases in the collection or wantlist of a user. Anyone can
read a public collection, but a private one can only be read with the
token of its owner. Collections and wantlists are Restricted Data, see
[Terms of use](#terms-of-use).

Each copy in a collection has a `media_condition` and a
`sleeve_condition` if the user graded it. The grades are factors from
best to worst, as in
[`dig_price_suggestions()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_price_suggestions.md),
so the two can be joined to price each copy in its own grade:

``` r

collection <- dig_collection("your-username", all = TRUE)
prices <- dig_price_suggestions(unique(collection$release_id))
collection |>
  dplyr::left_join(prices, by = dplyr::join_by(release_id, media_condition == condition)) |>
  dplyr::select(title, media_condition, price, currency)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   title              media_condition      price currency
#>   <chr>              <fct>                <dbl> <chr>
#> 1 Lantern Weather    Near Mint (NM or M-) 12.8  EUR
#> 2 Lantern Weather    Very Good (VG)        6.78 EUR
#> 3 Tidewater Sessions <NA>                 NA    <NA>
```

[`dig_tally()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_tally.md)
counts a collection by genre, style, format, label, artist, year, decade
or month added, without sending more requests. A copy with several
genres counts once for each:

``` r

dig_tally(collection, "genre")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   genre          n share
#>   <chr>      <int> <dbl>
#> 1 Electronic     3 1
#> 2 Pop            2 0.667
```

[`dig_plot()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_plot.md) draws
the same counts with ggplot2. Both also work on the output of the
database and list functions, for example to count the releases of a
label by decade or the credits of an artist by role:

``` r

dig_plot(collection, "genre")
dig_plot(dig_label_releases(4001, all = TRUE), "decade")
dig_plot(dig_artist_releases(3001, all = TRUE), "role")
```

![Lollipop chart of copies by genre in a made-up collection of 240
copies. Electronic is the most common, with 68 copies (28%), followed by
Rock and Funk / Soul.](reference/figures/README-genres.png)

Every plot has a title, a subtitle that says what is shown, alt text for
screen readers and the caption “Data provided by Discogs.”. Values are
written next to their marks, and the colours have enough contrast to be
read without relying on colour alone.

[`dig_price_stats()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_price_stats.md)
gets the lowest price and the number of copies for sale of releases.
With a token,
[`dig_price_suggestions()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_price_suggestions.md)
gets the price Discogs suggests for each condition and
[`dig_collection_value()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_collection_value.md)
the value of your own collection. Prices are never cached, and they are
Restricted Data, see [Terms of use](#terms-of-use):

``` r

dig_price_stats(c(1001, 1002))
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   release_id lowest_price currency for_sale blocked
#>        <int>        <dbl> <chr>       <int> <lgl>
#> 1       1001          4.5 EUR            12 FALSE
#> 2       1002         NA   <NA>            0 FALSE

dig_price_suggestions(1001)
#> # A tibble: 8 × 4
#>   release_id condition            price currency
#>        <int> <fct>                <dbl> <chr>
#> 1       1001 Mint (M)              14.3 EUR
#> 2       1001 Near Mint (NM or M-)  12.8 EUR
#> 3       1001 Very Good Plus (VG+)   9.8 EUR
#> # ℹ 5 more rows

dig_collection_value("your-username")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   username      minimum median maximum currency
#>   <chr>           <dbl>  <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>
#> 1 your-username    75.5   480.    1250 €
```

## Terms of use

The [API Terms of
Use](https://support.discogs.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009334593-API-Terms-of-Use)
apply to all data returned by tidycrates, and using it means accepting
them. In the United States, they require you to be at least 18 years
old.

Only some fields are available under the CC0 licence: titles, notes,
dates, formats, tracklists, identifiers, credits, versions and links of
releases, and the names, notes and releases of artists and labels. Other
fields, such as genres, styles, community counts and ratings, are not
listed as CC0 and can only be used under the Terms of Use.

Collections, wantlists, usernames and marketplace data, such as prices
and collection values, are Restricted Data. Discogs grants each user a
limited, personal licence to access and use them with their own token:
they may not be passed on to anyone else or used commercially, and their
use must respect the privacy of their owners. Keep them, and tallies and
plots of them, for your own use, and do not publish them. The Terms of
Use also forbid using the API to get around the Discogs marketplace.

Images are left out, because the people who upload them can hold their
own copyright. Functions for selling, such as listings and orders, are
left out too.

If you show data from Discogs, put “Data provided by Discogs.” next to
it with a link to the page on Discogs, which is in the `uri` column.
[`dig_plot()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_plot.md) adds
the text as a caption, and the link goes wherever you publish the plot.
Data that are more than six hours older than the Discogs website may not
be shown, and data may not be stored longer than needed, so cached
responses are never kept longer than six hours.

This application uses Discogs’ API but is not affiliated with, sponsored
or endorsed by Discogs. ‘Discogs’ is a trademark of Zink Media, LLC.

# Package index

## Setup

- [`dig_auth()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_auth.md) :
  Set the 'Discogs' token
- [`dig_user_agent()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_user_agent.md)
  : Set the user agent
- [`dig_rate_limit()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_rate_limit.md)
  : Check the rate limit

## Database

- [`dig_search()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_search.md)
  : Search the 'Discogs' database
- [`dig_release()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_release.md)
  : Get releases
- [`dig_master()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_master.md)
  : Get master releases
- [`dig_artist()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_artist.md)
  : Get artists
- [`dig_label()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_label.md) :
  Get labels

## Lists

- [`dig_artist_releases()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_artist_releases.md)
  : List the releases of an artist
- [`dig_label_releases()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_label_releases.md)
  : List the releases of a label
- [`dig_master_versions()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_master_versions.md)
  : List the versions of a master release

## Users

- [`dig_collection()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_collection.md)
  : List the collection of a user
- [`dig_wantlist()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_wantlist.md)
  : List the wantlist of a user
- [`dig_tally()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_tally.md) :
  Tally releases
- [`dig_plot()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_plot.md) :
  Plot releases

## Marketplace

- [`dig_price_stats()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_price_stats.md)
  : Get marketplace statistics
- [`dig_price_suggestions()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_price_suggestions.md)
  : Get price suggestions
- [`dig_collection_value()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/dig_collection_value.md)
  : Get the value of a collection

## Unnesting release data

- [`dig_tracklist()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md)
  [`dig_credits()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md)
  [`dig_formats()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md)
  [`dig_identifiers()`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/unnest_release.md)
  : Unnest release data

## Package

- [`tidycrates`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/tidycrates-package.md)
  [`tidycrates-package`](https://mcanzi.de/tidycrates/reference/tidycrates-package.md)
  : tidycrates: Tidy Data from the 'Discogs' API
